metricText: SBA Loan Program Performance Disaster program post-charge-off recovery amount.
note: PROPOSED: SBA Table 7 prints Disaster FY2024 post-charge-off recovery of $126,510,000, but admission needs a new SBA Loan Program Performance PDF parser plus authenticated first-print custody and historical anchors.
statisticalProduct: Loan Program Performance fiscal-year tables, Disaster program row, post-charge-off recovery

verification.reason: The official Table 7 PDF prints the exact Disaster fiscal-year post-charge-off recovery amount. The current source is a rolling PDF bundle whose prior-year amounts may be adjusted, so admission requires a new SBA PDF parser and authenticated release-time or versioned custody.

fetchNotes: The www.sba.gov asset URL returned HTTP 404; the official page redirects to legacy.sba.gov, where the dated FY2025 Q3 ZIP was available.
